meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 它会在分发、扫描、解析、生成卡片等节点记录操作事件,按 trace_id 串成证据链并写入向量索引,还提供按 trace_id、时间窗、官署检索历史证据的接口。
howto.when: 当你构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测与安全审计时使用;各官署在分发、扫描等关键操作节点调用它留痕。

say.text: 把这次运行的事件写入证据链,按 trace_id 串起来。
say.note: 生成证据链与向量索引条目。

say.text: 查询 trace_id 为 abc123 的全部历史证据。
say.note: 按 trace_id 返回可追溯证据链。

say.text: 列出最近一小时各官署的执行事件,用于审计。
say.note: 按时间窗和官署维度检索。

howto.what_en: It logs events at nodes like dispatch, scan, parse and card generation, chains them by trace_id into an evidence chain, writes a vector index, and offers a query API for history by trace_id, time window or agency.
howto.when_en: Use it when building multi-agent systems that need end-to-end observability and security audit, or when an agency calls it at a key operation node to leave a trace.

say_en.text: Write this run's events into the evidence chain, chained by trace_id.
say_en.note: Produces an evidence chain and vector index entries.

say_en.text: Query all historical evidence for trace_id abc123.
say_en.note: Returns the traceable chain for that trace_id.

say_en.text: List each agency's events from the last hour for audit.
say_en.note: Searches by time window and agency.
